bars = [p for p in ax.patches]
if len(bars) > 1:
    sorted_bars = sorted(bars, key=lambda b: b.get_x())
    n_groups = 2
    for i in range(0, len(sorted_bars), n_groups):
        if i + 1 < len(sorted_bars):
            bar1 = sorted_bars[i]
            bar2 = sorted_bars[i+1]
            cx1 = bar1.get_x() + bar1.get_width() / 2
            new_x = cx1 - bar2.get_width() / 2
            bar2.set_x(new_x)
            bar1.set_zorder(2)
            bar2.set_zorder(1)
